title: The cursor shows over the item wheel
why: His order 2026-10-15: the mouse cursor shows over the wheel while it is open, so the player never loses the cursor when the wheel closes. The raid canvas hides the OS cursor (the reticle is the pointer) and the wheel plates covered the reticle, so the cursor vanished under the wheel. With a mouse the arrow is up while the wheel is open and the reticle steps aside; a pad keeps its reticle.
now: The mouse arrow shows over the item wheel while it is open.
